decision: Support only as a newly versioned conservative engineering comparison policy, not as a verified bound on vendor solver numerical error.

formula.canonicalExpression: member end action = signed row of canonical 12x12 Timoshenko k times calibrated source-local native DISP, minus signed consistent fixed-end load.
formula.termSelection: Every structurally nonzero coefficient in the canonical stiffness row, including terms whose current displacement is zero; each structurally nonzero fixed-end-load term included. No algebraic rewriting, splitting, redundant zero terms, or residual-dependent selection.
formula.n: number of retained canonical product/load terms
formula.additionalRepresentationalSensitivity: sum(abs(k_ij)*0.5ULP_f32(d_j)) plus a separately specified output halfULP, if policy adopts these. This is a separate sensitivity term; it is not the native arithmetic remainder. Do not silently claim it accounts for input-stiffness/global-solve perturbations.
formula.derivedEquilibriumReaction: sum(abs(transform_coefficient)*member_end_allowance); add its own declared summation representation allowance if used.
formula.inputQuantization: Actual A/I/J and geometry are native float32; UserMaterial E/nu stored as doubles. Independent source-vs-actual forward response change is not an observed native residual, but cannot be called a rigorous bound without a separate validated sensitivity/interval analysis.

minimalEligibleScope: PKPM2027R1.0.1 executions with frozen native material, numeric section, geometry, load and output identity bindings.
Only the already independently reviewed principal-axis horizontal beams and vertical columns with zero roll, correct calibrated source axes and ends, and first-order linear response.
Canonical uniform line-load/nodal-load endpoint recovery, using source-local calibrated native six-DOF displacements; missing sentinels prohibited.
Fixed/pinned support DOFs only through previously qualified explicit boundary derivations/raw-DISP pin mapping; no silent zero fills.
Apply to all eligible member-end force components in all reviewed runs, not only STD089 failures; retain unmapped/outside-scope components as policy unavailable.
limits: The canonical K is independently constructed, not directly exported vendor stiffness.
Native As=5A/6 remains a response-checked hypothesis; source public convention can define it but that does not create a raw native As observation.
Vendor internal operation ordering, scalar types, factorization and force recovery precision are unknown. A textbook dot-product gamma does not establish the vendor error bound.
This policy broadens numeric acceptance even with unchanged atol/rtol fields; output must retain strict and policy-aware results with an explicit policy version.
No per-quantity constant, measured discrepancy or multiplier selected to clear the two failures.
Higher precision export/internals remains the preferred route if authored strict comparison is the target.
